gitCommit.subject: authz: audit attribution + dispositions (pv9 follow-ups: obe0, wfgj, opir, 2wzz) (#241)
gitCommit.body:
authz: audit attribution + dispositions (pv9 follow-ups: obe0, wfgj, opir, 2wzz) (#241)

* feat(audit): account.delete audit record (purses-obe0)

Extend AuditAction with "account.delete" and AuditTargetType with "user".
AccountDeletionService writes one append-only audit row after Phase 4 (PII
scrub) completes: actorId=userId, targetType="user", collectionId="__account__"
sentinel (column is NOT NULL; no natural collection context for account-level
events), metadata.ownedCollections=count. Integration test asserts the row
exists with correct attribution after DELETE /api/users/me.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* feat(audit): attribute item/photo deletion (purses-wfgj)

Extend AuditAction with "item.delete" and "photo.delete"; AuditTargetType
with "photo". Write an append-only audit row after each destructive soft-delete:
- DELETE /api/items/[id]: action="item.delete", actor from session, collectionId
  from the resolved item (requireApiItemCapability result).
- DELETE /api/collections/[id]/items/[itemId]/photos/[photoId]: action="photo.delete",
  actor from session, collectionId from route params.
Also adds comment at photo DELETE noting curator-level by owner decision (purses-opir).
Integration tests in item-photo-routes.integration.test.ts assert audit rows
exist with correct action/actorId/targetId/collectionId for both curator and
owner callers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* chore(authz): document curator photo-delete decision (purses-opir)

Owner explicitly confirmed full-curator-incl-delete-photos on 2026-06-22.
No code change needed: the irreversibility concern is mitigated by the
photo.delete audit attribution landed in purses-wfgj. The decision comment
is co-located in the photo DELETE route handler (same commit as wfgj).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* refactor(authz): remove no-op member PATCH (purses-2wzz)

No UI caller exists for PATCH /api/collections/[id]/members/[mid] and
members have no editable fields under the role model (UpdateMemberSchema
was z.object({}); repo update only wrote updatedAt). Remove the PATCH
export from the route, remove MemberController.updateMember and
UpdateMemberSchema/UpdateMemberInput from members.ts. Next.js returns 405
automatically for the now-unexported method. Remove PATCH from the
route-authz-enumeration stranger cases and drop the PATCH describe block
from members-routes.integration.test.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(audit): tx-bind item/photo delete audit (atomic attribution) + sentinel invariant test (purses-wfgj, purses-obe0)

Review MEDIUM: item.delete and photo.delete audit rows were written
POST-COMMIT, so a failed audit insert left the row soft-deleted with no
attribution — defeating wfgj. Wrap {soft-delete + audit insert} in one
withTransaction (mirrors ItemPurgeService's in-tx audit invariant): a
committed delete always has exactly one audit row; if the audit insert
throws, the soft-delete rolls back.

- items/[id] DELETE: ItemRepository(tx).softDelete + AuditLogRepository(tx).record
  in one withTransaction (bypass ItemController for the tx-bound path; PATCH
  still uses the controller). 404/403 authz unchanged, before the tx.
- photos/[photoId] DELETE: order is authz -> tx{ PhotoRepository(tx).delete +
  audit } -> post-commit blob del + variant sweep (external side effects that
  can't roll back, same as ItemPurgeService's post-commit blob sweep). Capture
  actorId before the closure (TS narrowing is lost inside the async callback).
  Comment now states the tx-bound invariant, not the misleading "append-only".

Tests: wfgj curator happy-paths now assert EXACTLY ONE audit row (atomicity).
Sentinel (LOW): comment at the account.delete write site names the invariant
(never JOIN audit_log.collectionId -> collections); new test asserts the
"__account__" sentinel row never surfaces in a real collection's
findByCollection view (V's surviving CB and the purged CA).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(api): audit attribution + member-PATCH removal (pv9 PR7)

Refs: purses-obe0, purses-wfgj, purses-opir, purses-2wzz

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* chore(graphify): refresh after pv9 PR7 (node shrink — removed member PATCH; --force)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH
